subject: Web Development
title: Same-Origin Policy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Same-Origin Policy.

hook.text: Imagine a malicious site reading your bank's page in another tab. The browser prevents that.

buildup.text: The same-origin policy restricts scripts from accessing data on a different domain.

discovery.text: An origin is defined by scheme, host, and port. All three must match for access.

twist.text: This strict rule breaks legitimate use cases. CORS headers exist to create safe exceptions.

climax.text: Same-origin policy is the single most important security boundary in every browser.

punchline.text: Every tab is an island by default.
